messages:
Sam (Sales): Heads-up: closed deal with Asteria Health today. Key asks in the SOW: private VPC deployment, Okta SSO, reserved Dedicated pool starting next quarter, and a 1-hr enablement for their ML infra engineers. Renewal cadence: annual; first renewal in ~11 months.
Priya (CS): Great — I'll own onboarding and customer success checkpoints. Planning 30/90 day check-ins.
Lee (Support): I'll run the support handoff and create initial runbooks. Need SSO metadata + certs and a contact for ops paging.
Rafael (Eng): I'll lead the private deployment plan and capacity QA. Can deliver an infra runbook draft by Wednesday EOD.
Sam (Sales): Contract note: they want burst fallback to hosted infra if dedicated saturates. We added a clause for burst credits in the SLA appendix.
Priya (CS): Owners: Onboarding = Priya; Infra/provisioning = Rafael; Support triage = Lee; Renewal outreach = Sam. I'll build the onboarding checklist and the 30-day success metrics doc.
Priya (CS): Action items below — react :white_check_mark: when you confirm.
Rafael (Eng): :white_check_mark: Need expected QPS and prompt sizes. Sam, can you paste them?
Sam (Sales): Model: open-llama-13b. Steady QPS ~12, peaks ~60 for short bursts (~45s). Median prompt ~350 tokens. P95 latency target <1.2s.
Lee (Support): Opening ticket CS-9023 to track SSO/provisioning artifacts. I'll start the runbook template and include incident playbooks.
Priya (CS): Proposed enablement: Thu 10am PT, 60m for ops + infra. Sam, confirm Asteria attendees.
Sam (Sales): Confirmed: Lina (CTO), Ravi (Infra lead), Marta (Security).
Rafael (Eng): For private deploy I'll need: VPC_CIDR, egress whitelist, KMS ARN for envelope encryption, and bastion info. Example snippet I'll paste into the questionnaire: 
``
VPC_CIDR=10.72.0.0/16
ALLOWED_EGRESS=[accounts.redwood-inference.com:443, metrics.redwood-inference.com:443]
KMS_ARN=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
``
Priya (CS): I'll send a short questionnaire to Asteria to collect those fields. Tagging risk RISK-ONBOARD-DELAY if provisioning exceeds 7 days.
InfraBot: Ticket CS-9023 created and linked to thread 1730123456.
Lee (Support): Renewal risk note: if we miss the 30-day checkpoint or see >30% throttling/errors, we escalate renewal outreach. I'll add alerts on burst error rate and quota saturation.
Priya (CS): Feedback and quality plan: two post-enablement surveys (2w and 8w) + an eval harness for their top 10 prompts to monitor regressions. Rafael, can you surface an eval webhook?
Rafael (Eng): Yes — I'll add a webhook and a small script. Endpoint draft: https://internal-hooks.redwood/asteria-evals. Will attach script to the onboarding doc.
Sam (Sales): Anything blocking kickoff?
Priya (CS): Blockers: SSO metadata and VPC values. If we receive them by EOD Tue we can hit the 30-day checkpoint.
Sam (Sales): I'll reach out to Ravi now and paste his reply here.
Lee (Support): Support milestone checklist planned: initial triage, runbook published, alerting enabled, and escalation test for 24/7. I'll assign owners after Rafael's infra doc lands.
Priya (CS): I'll create the internal transfer doc (drive) with owners, deadlines, and action items and share the link here.
Sam (Sales): Thanks all — high priority. I'll update the customer-facing timeline after enablement invite is accepted. :rocket:
